# SoundGen credit prices

Charged only when the job succeeds. Credits never expire; packs are one-time
(no subscription) at soundgen.ai/pricing. New accounts get 100 free credits.

## Music (by length; the per-second rate tapers)

| Length | Credits |
|---|---|
| 15 s | 10 |
| 30 s | 20 |
| 1 min | 38 |
| 1.5 min | 54 |
| 2 min | 69 |
| 3 min | 94 |
| 5 min | 125 |

Extending or rewriting part of a song (edit_song): the song's length plus the
result's length, each at the rate above.

## Everything else

| Action | Credits |
|---|---|
| Sound effect | 5 |
| Stem separation (vocals/drums/bass/other) | 6 |
| Stem separation with piano or guitar (deep) | 9 |
| Speech / lyrics to text | about 2 per minute, 1 minimum |
| Voice clone | 30 |
| Voice synthesis (per request, up to 5,000 characters) | 6 |
| AI cover / track recreation | 45 |
| Vocal harmonizer | 2 |
| Auto-mix, mastering, chord/tempo/key detection, melody, lyrics, arrangement, fills, sound design (ai-process) | 1 |
| Vocal tuning, noise removal, AI search, beat-match | 0 |
| Studio tools that only edit a project (add_track, add_midi_clip, add_effect, …) | 0 |
